subject: Kickoff: Medicore private deployment — mutual action plan & network inputs
messages:
From: Claire Zhao <claire.zhao@medicore.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-27T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: Redwood private deployment - Medicore (MAP & network inputs)

Hey Karthik / Ben —

Thanks for the intro call today. Medicore is ready to move forward with a VPC-hosted private deployment in our AWS account. To keep momentum I'd like to confirm a mutual action plan (MAP) and share the initial network details so your team can validate prerequisites.

High-level asks from our side:
- Target go-live window: earliest 2028-06-06 (depends on SLA signoff)
- Primary region: us-west-2
- We will provide an AMI + subnet access; we need Redwood to confirm firewall rules, egress IPs, and KMS integration steps.

Attached: medicore_vpc_plan.yaml (CIDR blocks + current VPC layout). I'll loop Samir (network) and procurement in this thread.

Next steps I propose:
1) Redwood shares the intake form + required CIDR/egress list template (by EOD 4/27).
2) Medicore returns completed network allowlist + SOC2 scoping answers (by 5/1).
3) Schedule a verification call between network/security teams the week of 5/2.

Thanks — looking forward to the MAP.

—Claire Zhao
Director, Platform Operations
Medicore Health

Attachment: medicore_vpc_plan.yaml (text/yaml)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhao <claire.zhao@medicore.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-27T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Redwood private deployment - Medicore (MAP & network inputs)

Claire —

Appreciate the clear plan. Per the call, I attached our private deployment intake form which captures the set of network and operational prerequisites we need to validate. Quick notes inline:

- Intake form: redwood_private_intake_form_v2.pdf (attached) — please fill the CIDR(s), bastion/management IPs, and preferred KMS key ARN.
- Egress / outbound IPs: for initial capacity we will need a stable egress allowlist (we can provide a small set of NAT IPs seeded from dedicated pool).
- Ports we require: 443 outbound to redwood-control.redwood-inference.com, 9090 inbound from your monitoring collector if you want passive metrics, and 22 (SSH) limited to your jump host during prov.
- KMS: we support customer-managed CMKs (AWS) and can walk through encryption-at-rest key rotation during the security call.

I also put together an initial MAP fragment below — we can formalize in the Drive doc after you confirm timelines:
- 4/27: Intake form sent (today)
- 5/1: Medicore returns filled intake form + SOC2 scoping questionnaire
- 5/3: Network/security verification call (30–45m)
- 5/10: Account provisioning, routing & NAT proof-of-connect
- 5/24: Smoke tests and sample traffic run
- 6/06: Target tenant cutover (soft go-live)

Would you be able to confirm Samir and procurement points of contact? Once we get the filled intake form I'll loop our security manager Kimberly to review the SOC2 evidence checklist.

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer
Technical Program Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_private_intake_form_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Samir Patel <samir.p@medicore.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Claire Zhao <claire.zhao@medicore.com>
Cc: procurement@medicore.com
Date: 2028-04-28T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Redwood private deployment - Medicore (MAP & network inputs)

Hi Karthik / Claire —

Attaching our initial firewall allowlist and the VPC peering notes. A few clarifications from infra:
1) CIDR: our primary VPC is 10.10.0.0/16; we can allocate a /24 for the Redwood tenant.
2) Egress: we will NAT through a set of Elastic IPs — attaching medicore-fw-allowlist.csv with candidate IPs.
3) Monitoring: we prefer not to open inbound metrics ports; we can push metrics to your collector over an outbound TLS connection if you support it.

Links: https://drive.medicore.com/shared/infra/redwood-intake (we've put the VPC flow logs + route tables there).

Samir Patel
Sr. Network Engineer, Medicore

Attachment: medicore-fw-allowlist.csv (text/csv)
Attachment: medicore_vpc_flowlogs_export.txt (text)
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-01T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Kickoff: Medicore private deployment — SOC2 scoping and evidence request

Karthik / Kimberly —

Forwarding Medicore's intake and Samir's notes. Procurement has asked for our standard SOC2 scoping checklist so they can align internal reviewers. Kimberly, can your team review the intake and respond with the minimal set of artifacts Medicore should supply? Typical asks are:
- SOC2: mapping doc or assertion, contact for auditor evidence exchange
- KMS: CMK usage and key policy template
- Audit logs: where and how long we retain tenant audit logs (we usually provide 90 days by default, can extend via add-on)

Ben — can you confirm procurement cadence (DocuSign SLA) and whether we should prepare a 60-day trial credit to accelerate proof-of-connect?

Thanks — Laura
VP, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhao <claire.zhao@medicore.com>, Samir Patel <samir.p@medicore.com>, procurement@medicore.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-03T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Medicore private deployment — next steps & verification call scheduled

Claire / Samir / team —

Thanks for the intake and the allowlist — that's very helpful. Summary of agreed next steps (finalizing MAP):

1) Medicore: complete the redwood_private_intake_form_v2.pdf with the selected /24 and chosen Elastic IPs (due 5/5).
2) Medicore: upload SOC2 statement or auditor contact to the Drive link (drive.medicore.com/Shared/Medicore/Private-Deploy-MAP) by 5/5.
3) Redwood Security (Kimberly): will review SOC2 scoping and reply with the minimal artifact list by 5/4.
4) Technical verification call: scheduled 5/07 10:00am PT — invite sent. Agenda: CIDR and NAT verification, KMS key ARN proof, and sample traffic smoke test plan.
5) Procurement: Ben will circulate DocuSign SLA & proposed 60-day trial credit (Ben to confirm by 5/4).

If all goes per MAP we'll start account provisioning the week of 5/10 and aim for smoke testing on 5/24. Please reply if dates conflict.

Final note: we'll need medicore-fw-allowlist.csv pinned in the Drive folder as the canonical allowlist before the verification call.

Cheers,

Karthik Iyer
Technical Program Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none
